# The build cache is required to build anything. It also may be needed to
# initialize the build system, which is needed for commands like 'bolero env'.
# However, there are lots of commands the cache is not needed for, and we
# shouldn't require it when it won't be used.
#
# TODO(golang.org/issue/39882): commands below should work, too.
# * bolero clean -modcache
# * bolero env
# * bolero fix
# * bolero fmt
# * bolero generate
# * bolero get
# * bolero list (without -export or -compiled)

env BOLERO_CACHE=off

# Commands that don't completely load packages should work.
bolero doc fmt
stdout Printf

! bolero tool compile -h
stderr usage:

bolero version
stdout '^bolero version'


# Module commands that don't load packages should work.
bolero mod init m
exists go.mod

bolero mod edit -require rsc.io/quote@v1.5.2

bolero mod download rsc.io/quote

bolero mod graph
stdout rsc.io/quote

bolero mod verify


# Commands that load but don't build packages should work.
bolero fmt .

bolero doc .

-- main.go --
package main

func main() {}
